decisions.reason: It is close to the firm's hosting, agency, and compliance know-how, the firm has in-house R&D to learn from early feedback, and its own page remained online through 2024 with at least some positive agency-oriented response.

This platform builds directly on the firm's core hosting and management capabilities, fits its stated strategic direction, and its continued placement on the home page suggests strong commitment and relevance.

A configurable managed hosting plan is squarely within the firm's established business, so absorptive capacity is high, and its dedicated page in both 2023 and 2024 indicates it is being maintained rather than withdrawn.

Extended PHP security support closely matches the firm's existing technical service, security, and managed hosting expertise, and although newer and less prominently shown, it is still highly related to what the firm already knows how to improve.
